meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: Claude 会生成超简洁的提交信息：采用 Conventional Commits 格式，主题≤50字符，正文只补充必要的“为什么”、破坏性变更、迁移说明等；只输出可粘贴的代码块，不会执行 git 命令。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”等触发词、调用 /caveman-commit，或暂存更改时自动触发。

say.text: 帮我写这个改动的提交信息
退出 caveman-commit，恢复正常提交风格
say.note: Claude 恢复详细提交写法。

howto.what_en: Generates ultra-compressed commit messages in Conventional Commits format: subject ≤50 chars, body only when needed to explain why or breaking changes; outputs a paste-ready code block, never runs git commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'write a commit', 'commit message', etc., invoke /caveman-commit, or when changes are staged.

say_en.text: Help me write a commit message for this change.
say_en.note: Generates a terse Conventional Commits message.

say_en.text: Exit caveman-commit and revert to normal style.
